g.title:
'$'''cat <<'''EOF''' > /tmp/dynamic.sh
#!/bin/bash
echo "Sourced dynamic script"
( ( echo "Nested in sourced" & ) )
declare -a local_arr=(a b c)
for val in "${local_arr[@]}", do
 echo "Sourced loop: $val"
done
EOF
' (1,098 us, 0.01%)
'@TRAP (USR1): echo "USR1 trap"\, ( ( echo "Nested in USR1" & ) )' (4,932 us, 0.03%)
'trap '\''echo "USR1 trap", ( ( echo "Nested in USR1" & ) )'\'' USR1' (27,521 us, 0.19%)
'trap '\''echo "TERM trap", ( eval "echo eval in trap" )'\'' TERM' (26,746 us, 0.19%)
'trap '\''echo "EXIT trap triggered", ( ( sleep 1 & ) & wait )'\'' EXIT' (26,301 us, 0.18%)
